sentences: When the sun has a big storm, it throws huge clouds of tiny charged **particles** into space, and some of them can reach Earth.
These particles shake Earth's **magnetic field**, and this can create electric **currents** in long metal wires on the ground.
In the 1800s, railway **signals** were sent through such long wires, so a strong solar storm could mix up the messages and hold trains back.
An old report, published in a science journal in 1871, said that a train in Exeter, England, was **delayed** this way by sixteen minutes in October 1841.
en.answer: 태양에 큰 폭풍이 일면, 태양은 전기를 띤 작은 입자들로 이루어진 거대한 구름을 우주로 내던지고, 그중 일부는 지구에 닿을 수 있다.
words: 지연된, 늦어진 (be delayed by + 시간: ~만큼 늦어지다)
